task: Add a service-account-only management API in codemie with identity guard, idempotent user/membership operations and user reads including deactivated users, for a customer-side Keycloak sync job (EPMCDME-16895).

key_reasoning.reason: New management router, new identity-based guard (no precedent beyond the Teams resolver), orchestration over UserManagementService, ProjectAssignmentService, AuthenticationService helpers and user repository read paths; must bypass switch locks in UserAccessService; route restriction for the service account outside the management API has no existing mechanism.

Closest pattern is the Teams resolver, which silently falls back on a miss and does not cover fail-closed authorization or route-scoped denial. Security-sensitive guard, none of the operations is idempotent today, reactivation affects shared active-only getters, auth-cache invalidation is missing on deactivation, and a 1s page of 100 at 60,000 users is unverified. The AC enumerates many edge cases with no existing parameterized test template.
About 8-10 modified (main.py, config.py, user_repository, user services, project assignment service, baselines) plus 3-4 new (router, guard, models, service) across several directories, plus tests.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped: security requirement and authentication/authorization guard
Component Scope bumped: touches multiple workflows (user, membership, auth cache) and shared services
